evals.prompt: acá tenés la grabación de pantalla de mi app (no tiene audio), sacale 3 o 4 clips verticales para reels con subtítulos
evals.expected_output: 3-4 vertical 1080x1920 mp4 files, each with a burned caption track, an audio stream, and a written narration; plus the timestamps chosen and why

evals.prompt: tengo este tutorial de 12 minutos en .mov, quiero shorts de menos de 30 segundos con voz en español
evals.expected_output: Clips honoring the 30s cap, Spanish TTS voice, captions, and a note on which beats were chosen

evals.prompt: does this machine even have what it takes to render video? check before we start
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor, reports ffmpeg/filters/fonts/TTS availability with OS-specific install commands for anything missing

evals.prompt: revisá la carpeta clips: decime si los videos quedaron bien o si algo está roto
evals.expected_output: Runs verify (or the equivalent ffprobe/volumedetect checks), reports per-file duration, resolution, audio presence and mean volume, names the broken clips and why

evals.prompt: quiero los clips con un título grande los primeros segundos y subtítulos estilo tiktok
evals.expected_output: Adds a per-clip title and renders with --style tiktok, then shows a frame proving the hook and the captions are both on screen and not clipped

evals.prompt: esto es para youtube, no lo quiero vertical: dejalo horizontal y editame el video completo
evals.expected_output: Uses --aspect auto (or 16:9), plan --full with contiguous beats and stitch, renders one joined horizontal file, and verifies shape, audio and duration

evals.prompt: no sé bien qué hacer con esta grabación, guiame
evals.expected_output: Asks at most three questions (destination, length, voice) with defaults, then proceeds without demanding timestamps or a transcript

evals.prompt: usando talkicut hacé un reel sobre las IA actuales
evals.expected_output: Researches the topic, fills `angle` with a non-obvious 'most think X, but actually Y' sentence, writes 3-6 beats (spoken hook, one of video/query/chart each, sourced numbers in charts, closing question), runs storyboard + make, delivers one 9:16 mp4 with voice, word-highlighted captions, music and credits.txt, without inventing facts

evals.prompt: hacé un reel sobre la RAM y ponele música y animaciones
evals.expected_output: Uses chart beats (counter/bar/line) with real, sourced RAM price data for the animations, real footage or on-topic images for the rest, runs make (NCS music is picked by default), and delivers one mp4 with audio

evals.prompt: hazme un video corto sobre el agua
evals.expected_output: Does not list obvious facts: finds a surprising angle first (e.g. a counter-intuitive number or a hidden cost), fills `angle`, builds the beats as hook -> context -> chart -> twist -> question, runs make and delivers one mp4
